title: Reasoning task contagion: GSM-Hard with source exit

notes: Uses GSM-Hard math problems — models can't memorize answers (numbers modified).
Contamination agent starts with wrong answer and exits at step 3.
Tests whether wrong REASONING spreads through the record, unlike factual claims where models are immune.
Compare: source stays vs source exits, memory mode vs chat mode.
This directly tests whether the Cost of Consensus sycophantic-conformity finding transfers to shared-record settings.
